reviews.title: Flight
reviews.text: Have been trying to fly from Newcastle to Oslo. Got as far as Aberdeen to then have onward part of same flight cancelled. Rescheduled for next day. The same problem again. Technical problems. Waiting to see if I will ever get to Oslo. Loganair seem to be operating ancient aircraft held together with who knows what (sticky tape?). I will never fly Loganair again. Suggest you all do the same.
reviews.author: I Dunkerley

reviews.title: So sad,
reviews.text: Cancelled - Rebooking - Delayed. Three codewords for Loganair. I have had more reliable trips with bushflights. Logistics and timeplanning is not Your strongest side. A big kudos to the lady in Sumburgh who did all she could, thanks. Shetland, Orkney and Scotland is great, and ferry is my choice next time. 2 points and thumbs up for Your Sumburgh team and flight crew. Good luck for the future Loganair, You need it!
reviews.author: tore b

reviews.title: What an embarrassment for Scotland!
reviews.text: I fly regularly from Inverness to Manchester and back, when I say regularly I mean every other week, and have done for a number of years. I use Loganair because I have no real alternative, train takes 9 hours, driving takes 6 hours. On the whole the flights are close to being on time, the cabin crew excellent although the inflight catering really does not reflect the very expensive fares. Your use of Menzies as your gate agents is something of a lottery, our gate agent didn't even know the flight had been cancelled. I've sufferd in silence for a loing time simply becuase Loganair have the worst customer service of all the airlines I have travelled on .....and I've been travelling all over the world for 40 years. I see no point in complaining becasue it is just a waste of time. Just last Friday, the 23rd, they cancelled the Inverness flight with 4 hours notice, in the text I recieved I was informed I could claim a refund or call the Customer Service number for more information. I called the number and got a message saying the volume of calls was so high that they would not even put me in a queue and the message promptly ends. Now, I'm aware that there is an Aberdeen flight at pretty much the same time from Manchester, so I smell a cunning plan. Since we have been given absolutely no information or reason as to the cause of the cancellation, it is my suspicion that the 7 passengers who turned up at the checkin desk for Inverness was the reason they cancelled. Simply not enough
reviews.author: JD

reviews.title: Absolute Shambles
reviews.text: Being a resident of Orkney, my only option for airport travel is sadly Loganair. In their time serving (not well at all) the Orkney islands, I have NEVER had a flight leave on time… on countless of occasions I have missed connecting flights and had to spend a night in either Aberdeen, Edinburgh or Glasgow. Give them their due the flight stewards on board are friendly and attentive, I think the problem lies further up the chain. I would strongly advise NOBODY to travel with this airline if you like to arrive at your destination on time. At all costs I try my upmost to travel to Scotland Mainland using the ferry services, as they can actually depart at the time they are supposed to. I am planning to start a petition to boycot Loganair in Orkney and try to get another airline to serve us. Whoever that is I don’t care, they have to be better than this pathetic excuse of an airline. Hang your head in shame loganair
reviews.author: Ross W

reviews.title: Not reliable so allow extra time
reviews.text: Their aircraft is out of date and not equipped to land in weather that most others can. So the island constantly experiences delays. They cancel at short notice with awful little for alternatives and won’t cover you for any out of pocket expenses. Customer service are a disaster
reviews.author: Sheeraz S

reviews.title: Very poor customer service and a very expensive national flight
reviews.text: My return flight between Cardiff and Edinburgh cost £246. While flying out from Cardiff airport, the flight was delayed due to thunderstorms and the announcement screen until the very moment we stepped into the airplane, did not announce which gate and at what time the gate will open. I saw a small cardboard sign with Edinburgh written on and that was the announcement! On the way back, the gate number had changed and nobody announced it and by complete accident I discovered that I am in the wrong gate. Also, for no given reason the boarding was delayed for 15 minutes and after sitting in the plane there was another 15-20 min delay. The captain did not explain and did not even mention at what time we get to Cardiff. Has this airline got any care for passengers? Surely for £246 paid from my pocket, you can spend some pennies to make some announcement and display the gates correctly?
reviews.author: Paris c

reviews.title: Flight to Isle of Barra
reviews.text: When I decided to travel to the Hebrides, I based my itinerary around a flight to Barra. Landing on a sandy beach was on my bucket list and I was not disappointed. Everything went as planned on a beautiful day. Thank you, Loganair.
reviews.author: Barbara R

reviews.title: Find any other possible means of transport
reviews.text: Booked a Loganair flight for our 3 day trip to Orkney. Flight was cancelled just as we were waiting to take off - in plane - and we were told we had to transfer to afternoon flight. This meant missing tour we'd booked for first day. Transferring was a nightmare - well over an hour of mucking about at Loganair check in where ground staff were clearly not coordinating with head office. Then we were offered lunch vouchers, but given wrong information about them - another 30 minutes of mucking about. Only to reenter airport (having to go through airport security a second time) to find the food vouchers were not accepted at any of the venues we approached. My advice to others will be to find any other means of transport possible if not wanting to spend 1/3 of your holiday in the not so delightful Edinburgh airport.
reviews.author: Belinda

reviews.title: Cracking Airline
reviews.text: Loved everything about Loganair. Lovely staff, a friendly pilot who spoke overhead, clean and on time. A wonderful flight.
reviews.author: Traveller

reviews.title: Delay due to thick fog in mainland Scotland.
reviews.text: On arrival at the airport I was informed that all flights until further notice were cancelled because of thick fog over mainland Scotland. Customer service without any hesitation set about rearranging flights for my travel next day. I was assigned a hotel in the town taxis too and from the hotel arranged for next morning ,Lunch, dinner and breakfast. The room was very comfortable and the staff very friendly. After a good nights rest the taxi picked me up at the hotel and took me straight to the airport where I was booked on the flight straight away. All paid for. LoganAir's staff have to be commended for the difficult position they found themselves in but dealt with it very professionally. Thank you so much to all the staff who made what could have very well been a nightmare a very pleasant experience. Thank you all. William Ogilby.
reviews.author: William Ogilby

reviews.title: Unacceptable delays and poor customer care
reviews.text: Most dissatisfied with customer care. Made excuses when I pointed out that both flights had been delayed over 2 hours and with no warning for one of them although flights had been delayed all week due to "crewing issues. " With any feeling of goodwill they would have paid my reasonable taxi claim after arriving after all trams and buses had stopped.
reviews.author: Judy B

reviews.title: Late as usual
reviews.text: Every flight with this awful airline is late. It's become an expected occurance. Unfortunately, I have no control over which flights are booked otherwise I'd avoid Loganair forever. Scotland's airline, not a positive advertisement for the country at all.
reviews.author: Danny K

reviews.title: Excellent Flights
reviews.text: I flew with Logan Air on the 9th of March with my husband and back on the 12th of March, to visit family. On both occasions the service was excellent. Scottish hospitality at its best. The cabin crew member on the way out was Lorna, and on the return was Angela. Both ladies were very approachable, efficient and friendly, and gave the passengers a very warm welcome. The pilots were very informative with their announcements and did a great job arriving on time on both occasions.
reviews.author: Joan S

reviews.title: Pretty unimpressive to say the least
reviews.text: This route must make real money for Loganair, because of the constant movement of offshore workers between the two places. Sadly, this does not cause Loganair to seek to improve matters. We have made the return journey three times in the past nine months, each time booking months ahead and each time paying close on £400 a head for flights of one and a quarter hours on a twenty three year old cramped aircraft with (by now) worn and uncomfortable seats. And the token shortcake biscuit is the size of a fifty pence piece. If we could face the drive we would do it, but sadly age is not on our side. Should passenger numbers drop, no doubt Loganair with instantly withdraw this service, as it did the Norwich to Edinburgh service.
reviews.author: John M

reviews.title: Shockingly bad
reviews.text: After the USUAL Edinburgh to Stornoway (Edinburgh is almost constantly delayed and the excuses are just a joke) delay getting to Stornoway the return flight was actually on time. That is where the good news ends. Good god is their fleet a shambles, aluminium trays that vibrate like you would not believe. They should supply ear defenders. The props start, we can expect vibrations but come on, every single fold up tray vibrating - just think about it - aluminium against aluminium. Deafening, uncomfortable seats to boot. The hospitality, such a stereotypical tea / coffee / shortbread or caramel wager. Do people think we only eat bloody shortbread or caramel wafers in Scotland. As a “National” airline for Scotland - what a pile of utter crap. It takes longer but you don’t have the weight restrictions, get decent food and sail on time way more than Loganair - take the damn ferry.
reviews.author: DangerDoc

reviews.title: Flight time change, no response from airline
reviews.text: Booked flight Wednesday, and within 12 hours they changed departure time to five hours later. No response from airline on either a refund or alternative flight. Filled out the limited form several times, but have yet to hear anything. What’s the point of a schedule if the airline won’t adhere to it. Impossible to use this airline if you have any type of a schedule to meet.
reviews.author: corthay

reviews.title: Garbage.
reviews.text: Garbage airline. Always late. Causes havoc and wasted money with pre booked onward journeys. Useless.
reviews.author: NET

reviews.title: Absolutely Fabulous Service
reviews.text: We have used Logan Air twice in the last few months and honestly I would be reluctant to use a different service from this. We were lucky enough to be served by Paul on our first trip to Glasgow last Autumn, he is so welcoming and friendly, excellent customer service and we were lucky enough to have him on our return flight yesterday. On our return flight one of the passenger's was delayed due to an unexpected holdup on the Motorway but the Captain waited for him which I thought was a really lovely thing to do. When you are flying to Derry you are obviously not trying to make a connecting flight so why rush! Well done Logan Air, it is nice to know that we still have caring individuals in our society. It is fantastic to have a service like this on our doorstep instead of having to go all the way to Belfast or Dublin. The only thing that continually baffles me is why the train does not stop at the Airport which has everything to do with bad planning and nothing to do with Logan Air.
reviews.author: Maura H

reviews.title: Abominable
reviews.text: After arriving at my outgoing airport 2 hours prior to checkin, the flight was cancelled about thirty minutes later. Three days later I am still trying to work out how to claim a refund. Thus far I have almost or possibly scammed, have searched for something called BSP on a loganair page, and am totally mystified. First time with Loganair.................guess what? Correct answers on a postcard, first prize a flight on loganier, runner up gets two!
reviews.author: James K

reviews.title: Total disgrace of an airline
reviews.text: In a total of thirty flights either my husband or myself have made on the Aberdeen/Manchester route in the last four months only three flights have actually been on time. They are a joke of an airline who couldn’t care less about the chaos they create in peoples lives with their constantly late flights, delays and flight cancellations. They call themselves‘Scotland Airline’ but they are an embarrassment to anyone Scottish…they are a total disgrace. They get away with this abysmal service as they’re the only airline flying this route so people have no option but to use them. Words can’t express the contempt I have for this airline.
reviews.author: Bev M

reviews.title: Lovely flight great service
reviews.text: I have flown Logan Air a few times recently as my son moved to The Isle Of Man for work. Each time the flights have been on time (even arriving early). The pilots give clear announcements and I always find the cabin crew very friendly and efficient. Yesterday I was served my Angela who was very welcoming. It’s great to have a Scottish Airline keeping the island communities so well connected. Thank you Logan Air.
reviews.author: Joan S

reviews.title: Poor lifeline service
reviews.text: Business trip booked a few weeks ago - just found out my flight is cancelled due to strikes. Loganair did not inform me of this and my trip is in less than a week. They charge extortionate prices for an unreliable lifeline service and are able to get away with such poor practice due to lack of competition at Sumburgh airport. Without the accountability of competative airlines they take advantage of their customers who have little other option than to use their airline. Finding out your flight has been changed or cancelled last minute, or not being informed at all, is a regular occurrence. Loganair does not care for their customers at all. They are slobby because they can get away with it. They could do so much better. This happens far too often. They are also awkward to deal with, will do whatever they can to prevent you reclaiming flight costs when your flights are cancelled at their fault and are awkward about supporting you rebook a flight that has been cancelled. They sometimes refuse to pay you back when you are entitled to a refund. I wiuld never book with Loganair if I had the option. An extremely unhelpful service.
reviews.author: Elle M

reviews.title: LoganTairD
reviews.text: Without doubt the worst airline I have ever used. Then again, it was linked to British Airways so no surprise there. Zero customer service, second hand knock off planes and always late. This time, a mere 17 hours. I haven’t flown domestic for several years after saying I never would again. This time I mean it. Avoid LoganTurD like the plague. Abysmal. Airline of Scotland, shame on you.
reviews.author: John P

reviews.title: Flights changed at the last minute
reviews.text: We were due to fly on the 18th from Edinburgh to Derry with our dog. The aircraft was changed at the last minute and we were advised that we could either not fly or move the flights to glasgow. This meant we lost all our money for parking, had to pay for additional parking, extra diesel to travel to glasgow. This isn't in the T'Cs, although I've since been told that when you phone to book the dog they mention it on the call. This isn't highlighted and certainly not something that you're told is extremely likely. I've now had 6 flights with Loganair and every single one has had some sort of change/considerable delay (8hrs delay on the 29th Dec) I have to book one more time to get my dog back to Scotland, after that I'll never use Logan again
reviews.author: Shaun M

reviews.title: As a lifeline service for the Scottish Islands communities the treatment of passengers due to strikes is appauling
reviews.text: As a lifeline service for travel for island residents, the treatment of your customers who are adversely affected by strike action is beyond appalling. (whether this be through your own staff, or stakeholders that you do business of whom directly impacts the availability of your service to your customers) . As residents of our rural communities, we rely on your service as a lifeline for travel to and from our islands. It is often the case that you have to plan onward travel the way in advance and travel dates and times become interdependent on this. The fact that you do not or will not be willing to compromise and refuse to be reasonable when your customers cannot wait until the day of travel to see if their flight has been cancelled or not is just completely unjustifiable. The only response from your management was to raise a dispute with the bank. Your flight prices are already extortionate as it is, and runs as a service for the privileged few. However, the treatment of a customer base that is trapped with your horrific quality of care due to a monopoly and lack of competition is bang out of order. Especially given the amount of public subsidy that is given. But oh wait, we get a free 25p caramel wafer bar when we do manage to miraculously catch a flight to make up for it. Joke.
reviews.author: Jack Whitwell

reviews.title: Logair should be taken out back and put down like a rabid dog.
reviews.text: I am here to claim compensation for the involuntary denial for the boarding of my flight. I had all of my documents ready, and I was more than on time for my flight, and being denied for boarding was no fault of my own. Upon arrival at the airport, and of course being given Zero warning of any kind beforehand, I was informed my flight was overbooked by 6 or more seats. This flight was for one of the most important events of my life. I am a newlywed, my wife and I have been apart due to circumstances currently entirely outside of my control, after months apart, we worked long, cold, hard months and saved to finally be united for a week in Bangkok for our first Christmas together. I had booked my flights with a very safe 7-hour layover which would have given me plenty of time to make my next flight, my original Loganair flight was due to depart from one simple part of Scotland to the next, but I was not offered a replacement flight that would make catching my connection possible. I forcibly missed ALL of my following flights because of the stupidity and blatant greed of Loganair. I was offered a mere pathetic excuse, caused enormous suffering both emotionally, monetarily, and physically, as well as the unnecessary emotional distress for my wife and family. This atrocious and unforgiveable mishandling of Loganair as a business and of our lives as customers is outrageous. I had no choice but to take another flight that was completely worthless as it caused me to miss all of my fo
reviews.author: TimothyG

reviews.title: Disappointing response
reviews.text: I was recently stranded in Edinburgh airport due to Logan air cancelling my morning flight. It happens fair enough.I had to wait in long line to be told to stand in another long line to be told to go back to original line then told go back into the line that they took me out of. Not a good start. Couldn’t get me in the next flight mainly because they taking me in and out of queues but early evening one was ok. Well 1 hour before that flight they delayed the flight 3.5 hours then 1 hour before they cancelled. Why ?? because someone forgot Southampton closes early. So the delay shouldn’t even of been an option. As you can imagine spending 12 hours in an airport fora simple domestic trip with constant cancellations was pretty frustrating. They booked me a hotel which was nice and a morning flight. Obviously that flight was delayed. But eventually I did get back. I had to pay the ridiculous extra charge for the car park. Which apparently to Logan air was my problem for not booking It with them. (No they don’t do parking) I lost a days pay, forced to pay a parking charge and a day wandering Edinburgh airport. The main thing that annoyed me was total lack of organisation and forcing people with cancelled flight to continually queue and rebook.
reviews.author: steven

reviews.title: Brilliant
reviews.text: It is years since I travelled because I need assistance. I asked for it on my trip. I cannot praise this service enough. My stewardess went out of her way to make me feel comfortable. It was a joy of a trip. One I will be doing again in May. Treated like a Queen. Thankyou to all concerned 👍🥰🤗
reviews.author: Patricia

reviews.title: Worst Airline in Europe
reviews.text: Just the 1.5 hours late at the moment. My 17th flight in 3 years. 1 has been on time.How this useless lot got to take over this route when Flybe went down is beyond me.3 times the price to sit on an ancient plane and arrive and depart late every time.They are up for sale and if I had the money I would buy them to close them down. Yippee flight now called but will most likely sit on it for an hour awaiting a slot.
reviews.author: Tim J

reviews.title: Frustrated at poor service and lack of communication!
reviews.text: Like most of the recent reviews on TripAdvisor about Loganair, mine is equally frustrating! My return trip from Edinburgh to City of Derry was cancelled shortly before boarding. What really astounded me however was the lack of information and/or explanation that followed. The ground staff were lovely but were as ill informed as the passengers. I asked them to book me on an Easyjet flight to Belfast later that evening but they weren't authorised to do that. I went ahead and booked as had to get back that night and 10 minutes later they received authorisation to book passengers with easyjet. Talk about disorganisation! Because I booked my own flight home (I had no choice), Loganair refused to pay my taxi to Derry so I had to bum a lift from some kindhearted passengers who had their taxi authorised??crazy or what? To add insult to injury,some of the passengers I have kept in contact with have had their easyjet flight refunded. But not me!! I have contacted Loganair twice but the silence is deafening. I have no intentions of letting this lie and will exhaust every avenue until my flight is refunded and compensation paid. Poor show overall
reviews.author: Helena B
